Career Profile

As a seasoned Senior Lead DevOps Engineer, I bring a wealth of experience working with premier brands and significant projects. My expertise lies in driving development efficiency, ensuring robust operational practices, and fostering innovation through advanced automation and CI/CD practices.
I am adept at mentoring team members, offering one-on-one and group guidance, and actively participating in the hiring process to build strong, cohesive teams. My passion for hands-on work is complemented by a strategic oversight of project roadmaps and long-term company objectives, ensuring alignment with business goals.
Play a key role in managing security vulnerabilities, proactively working to prevent breaches and safeguard data integrity. My ability to navigate high-pressure situations and lead cross-functional teams to successful project completions is a testament to my dedication and strategic thinking.
In my current role, I am not just a leader but also a committed contributor, balancing my managerial responsibilities with a love for hands-on technical work. My goal is to continue growing within the DevOps sphere, aiming for higher management roles while maintaining a deep involvement in project execution and company direction.
